title: Pilot MEDIUM — verified token telemetry readback
description: Execute the first real Item 8 MEDIUM-risk pilot by adding deterministic readback and integrity validation for persisted token telemetry records so later calibration can consume only canonical, untampered explicit-usage evidence. The task remains isolated from product runtime, database, API, dependencies and required workflows.

external_gate_evidence.rule: MEDIUM requires exact-artifact independent Review PASS and ACTIVE lock evidence. Security and Project Owner Human Gate are not required unless effective risk escalates to HIGH.

acceptance_criteria.description: A persisted canonical telemetry record can be read back by task id from .eqcofe/telemetry/<task_id>.json and validates to the same deterministic record produced from its explicit usage events.
Readback fails closed when derived aggregate fields, task binding, storage path, budget status, provenance, terminal state or calibration eligibility are inconsistent with the explicit source events.
Persistence validates record integrity before writing and never accepts fabricated or tampered aggregate telemetry.
The PR changes exactly the five authorized pilot paths and does not mutate product runtime, API, database, migration, dependencies, workflows, canonical roadmap or risk/merge-policy controllers.
Deterministic classification remains MEDIUM, requiring Review plus Verification with Human Gate NOT REQUIRED; any escalation to HIGH stops this pilot and follows HIGH policy.
Exact-head canonical verify, Phase A and Merge Policy pass before protected workflow merge, followed by exact-SHA post-merge verification before MEDIUM completion is claimed.
